parquet_axis_note: parquet x = perception X, parquet z = perception Y (floor), parquet y = height. ros_rep103 sign flip (floor_z = -perception Y) is NOT applied in parquet.

phantom_filter._note: PHANTOM_STATIC = alive >= static_duration_s within a static_extent_m box (fixtures, jittering ghosts, staff at a station). STATIC_SUSPECT = alive >= suspect_duration_s within suspect_extent_m. PHANTOM_MICRO = never moved (path<min_path_m and extent<min_extent_m). FLICKER_SHORT = shorter than min_duration_s. Only VALID ids enter journey analytics. Luca 2026-09-16: STATIC_SUSPECT (5 min in 1.5 m) are customers waiting at served counters -> keep them in journeys.

vendor._note: Luca 2026-09-16: vendor waits ~3 s before publishing a new id -> back-date each birth by 3 s when reasoning about entry time. No 30 s reset exists: 30 s deaths are tracker losses.

exit_region._note: No EXIT ROI in the twin. Luca 2026-09-16: customers leave to the right (east) of the checkouts, then down (south-east lobby).

_data_policy: All journey analytics run on the raw 10 Hz LiDAR feed (parquet/JSONL). track_positions (10 s samples) and zone_visits are benchmarks only, never inputs.

association._note: Operating point chosen on the blind artificial-fragmentation validation (95_validate/96_score_lab, 2026-09-14): precision ~0.90 on judgeable links, recall ~0.50 (0.55 for gaps <= 12 s). Heading, vendor velocity, occlusion prior and topology ratio carried no measurable information once walkable distance and stature were in; their weights are 0 but the components are still computed and stored for the debugger. min_time_gap < 0 allows the ~3 s vendor confirmation overlap.

checkout_fixed_object._note: Copied from 150_queue_wait.py. Daily KPIs exclude any id with a visit >= fixed_s in one checkout ROI, plus any visit >= near_s whose mean position is within near_m of such a spot. Do not change without recording here.
